scope: Current CAD and nominal layer-grid illustration; expected last open plane and first covering plane require native slice review.

conventions.warm_white: ASA Aero White GFB02; solid shading does not depict foam cells or emitted roads
conventions.accent: inserted ring or ASA Aero deposited after the expected pause
conventions.arrow: explanatory insertion arrow, not a component
conventions.gray_tile: cropped build-plate proxy, not full printer bed
conventions.steel_gray_rod: 3.175 mm cylindrical guide proxy; no mounting end hardware depicted
conventions.cutaway: front half removed for visibility; the printed body is one connected solid

hero.caption: Current one-piece ASA Aero float beside an axial cutaway, with one RC62 at Z14.0 mm.

exploded.caption: One ASA Aero CAD body in cutaway and one RC62 ring lifted for identification. The ring is inserted while the body is still printing.

section.caption: The 36 × 28 mm ASA Aero body surrounds a 3.60 mm deep enclosed annular pocket and a continuous 4.8 mm guide bore.

plate-aero.caption: One ASA Aero body prints upright, flat bottom attached to the glued Engineering plate. Gray is a cropped plate proxy.

paused-body.caption: Current CAD clipped at the expected last open plane Z16.0, before covering plane Z16.2. Native pause and covering paths require separate review.

magnet-seat.caption: Lower one RC62 into the open annular pocket, keeping the ASA Aero body attached to the plate. Accent identifies the inserted ring; the arrow shows insertion.

magnet-seated.caption: Cutaway of the expected pause state: RC62 flat on the Z12.4125 pocket floor, below both rims, with the guide bore clear.

roof.caption: Accent highlights the ASA Aero body above the expected pause plane. The inner collar and outer band meet the pocket cover, and the guide bore remains open.

finished.caption: The current one-piece 36 × 28 mm ASA Aero CAD envelope with an open 4.8 mm guide bore. Finished print dimensions and service behavior require physical evidence.

guide-fit.caption: A 3.175 mm guide rod proxy passes through the 4.8 mm bore: 0.8125 mm nominal radial clearance. The cutaway shows the enclosed ring clear of the rod.
